verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
OMUSUMBA-omulungi
Kuuma-endiga zo zonna;
Mpaawo-alizisikula
-Okuva mu mikono gyo.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Bulijjo twewombeeke
Okukugoberera,
Ng'abo abaatusooka,
Tukuumibwe-okwagala.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Bulijjo beera kumpi
Tuyige-eddoboozi lyo;
Tuleme-okukyamanga
Nga tuva mu kkubo lyo.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Yonna gy'onootutwala,
Tukugobererenga,
Okutuuka mu ggulu
Tufuge wamu naawe
